# Caller guidance: copilot

This page is for whoever briefs copilot. The model does not read it.

## Use

- Install `copilot/copilot-instructions.md` where Copilot reads repository instructions. Copilot reads that file and never this page.

## Briefing guidance

### Do

- Give it small single-repo pull requests, because its quota is credits. (`lessons:copilots-quota-is-credits-and-a-reviewer-still-caught-a-startup-failure-2026-10-07-evening`)

### Do not

- Merge its pull request without a Claude review; in the measured month every one needed fixes. (`lessons:every-copilot-pull-request-needed-fixes`)

### Review gate

- Review is required, and the reviewer must differ from the author.
- Check `test_vs_behaviour`: its wording is in `copilot/copilot-instructions.md`. (`lessons:every-copilot-pull-request-needed-fixes`)
- Check `workflow_permissions`: its wording is in `copilot/copilot-instructions.md`. (`lessons:copilots-quota-is-credits-and-a-reviewer-still-caught-a-startup-failure-2026-10-07-evening`)
